evidence.title: Achievement Badge — React Achievement Badge Component

name: Trophy UI
summary: Open-source gamification UI kit: 18 copy-paste React components for streaks, achievements, leaderboards and points.
description: Gamification components built on shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS v4, installed with the shadcn CLI into React or Next.js projects: streak cards, calendars and badges, achievement badges, grids and unlock animations, leaderboard rankings and podiums, points badges, charts and level timelines. Styled with semantic design tokens (including rank and achievement tokens) so themes stay portable.
contains: 18 components in 4 groups: streaks, achievements, leaderboards, points & levels
install via shadcn CLI (shadcn registry items), e.g. Streak Badge, Leaderboard Rankings, Points Chart
gamification design tokens: achievement, rank-1 … rank-3
docs: introduction, usage, styles, per-component API pages
